name: Tomitake Jirou
source:
A freelance photographer who visits Hinamizawa for the purpose of shooting wild birds. He seems to visit every year, and it's shown that he's on friendly terms with [url=/c3788]Mion[/url] and [url=/c3787]Rena[/url]. He seems to be interested in [url=/c3861]Takano[/url], and he's always asking her to date and form a relationship.

[spoiler]Tomitake served as a sniper in the army. After he suffered from an eye injury, he was moved to the position of sniping instructor. He holds the rank of First Lieutenant in the JSDF.[/spoiler]

[From [url=https://07th-expansion.fandom.com/wiki/Jirou_Tomitake]Jirou Tomitake[/url] on 07th Expansion Wiki]
